newsitem.title: USA: CBO economic assumptions ready next week - official.
newsitem.headline: CBO economic assumptions ready next week - official.

text.p: The Congressional Budget Office is expected to have completed its economic assumptions next week, Douglas Hamilton, chief of fiscal policy studies at CBO, said Tuesday.
"We should be locking in those assumptions next week ... the economic assumptions should be finished," Hamilton told reporters after speaking to an economist group.
Hamilton would not comment on how those assumptions would compare with prior CBO estimates.
He also said that the numbers for the CBO's budget deficit projection had not yet been finalized.
The CBO does the economic projections first, and then uses those projections in calculating its budget estimates, he said.
"None of these numbers are finalized yet, and we're still working on them," Hamilton said.
